scope: Observation/target receivers, not new proof, data admission or runtime permission.

receivers.input_contract: Finite admitted gARG/topology and all compatible abstract continuations.
receivers.result: Opposite whole-population specieslike targets while preserving old edges and ancestry.
receivers.limit: Not equal sequence likelihoods or an empirical species-delimitation theorem.

receivers.input_contract: Declared owner family or distinct-symbol independent-block inheritance model.
receivers.result: Scoped owner-bit criterion and sampled-family component recovery law.
receivers.limit: Not inferred ownership, general pedigree recovery or independent blocks from recombination alone.

receivers.input_contract: Fixed positive pre-hybrid wait, admitted family and finite contemporaneous allocations.
receivers.result: All-copy-uniform closeness and known-pair passive rare-route locus cost.
receivers.limit: Not arbitrary reticulate bases, hidden-coin readouts or every sequence channel.

receivers.input_contract: Known pair with the same original-ID registry and accessible ideal forcing.
receivers.result: Passive versus forced cost comparison at fixed source parameters/confidence.
receivers.limit: No physical actuator, general policy optimum or new model run.

receivers.input_contract: Observed iid labels or fixed relation with justified channel/calibration and confidence events.
receivers.result: Collision/diversity intervals and supported threshold decisions.
receivers.limit: Not latent semantic/biological richness or downstream optimization preservation without adapters.
